traits.silhouette: A small upright biped, child-sized, hunched forward on bent kangaroo-like legs with big haunches; thin arms held up in front of the chest; a row of long quills from the crown down the back.
traits.head: A big bald alien-like head, wider at the top, with huge black almond eyes slanting up, a small nose, a small lipless mouth (fangs in some drawings), no ears to speak of.
traits.limbs: Thin arms bent at the elbow with long clawed fingers; legs with a thick thigh, a backward hock and long three-toed clawed feet.
traits.hide: Scaly grey-green skin flecked and blotched with dark spots, a paler belly.
traits.colours: Grey-green to green body, dark green-black blotches, pale green-grey belly, black eyes, pale quills.
child: standing on two legs like a little alien kangaroo
